question: What will go through non-eating by day?
premises: divasāt nāśanena eva vayo mṛtyuṃ gamiṣyate
non-eating by day is the means
inference: Through non-eating by day, age and death will go.
uncertainties: whether vayo and mṛtyuṃ are separate objects
plain_english: Through non-eating by day, age and death will go.
